problem_statement: Stale commit SHA in delivery_manifest_sprint16.json pointing to Sprint 15 base commit 60958114...
root_cause: Artifact generation script executed before Git commit creation. Because a Git commit hash is a cryptographic digest of its tree, parents, author, and timestamp, a committed file cannot contain its own future SHA without a self-referential paradox. In Sprint 16 initial run, the script fell back to HEAD, which was Sprint 15 base.

remediation_protocol.stage_1_feature_freeze: Code and tests committed to produce verified feature_commit_sha.
remediation_protocol.stage_2_manifest_generation: Delivery manifest generated referencing the established feature_commit_sha.
remediation_protocol.stage_3_closure_verification: Post-commit recovery and closure artifacts record both feature and final SHAs.
